title: Are Political and Charitable Giving Substitutes? Evidence from the United States
authors: Pınar Yıldırım; Andrei Simonov; Maria Petrova; Ricardo Nicolas Perez Truglia
eligible_reason: Experiment 1 (Table 3): county-week ARC donations on a foreign-disaster window indicator iii (dis_k400_after, merged m:1 by week, so common to all counties and switching on and off), with county, month-of-year and year FE and time-varying mailing controls; time-series shock, not unit-specific adoption. Experiment 2 (Tables 4-5): border county-pair design with continuous IHS political ad spending (ad_01, sineads) and pair x bimonth FE. No binary staggered adoption.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe. ARC donations (scrambled), FEC donations, Kantar ads, IRS charitable deductions.
data_files_note: ReadMe.pdf: RCgen.dta contains 'scrambled donations to the American Red Cross'; the Table 4 border file is 'RC simulated data' with scrambled ARC donations.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract. No staggered binary design; ARC donation data scrambled.
